title: Scopely acquires Stumble Guys developer Kitka Games for undisclosed sum
content: Mobile game publisher Scopely has acquired Kitka Games, the Finnish studio behind Stumble Guys, the popular party battle royale game with over 500 million downloads. The acquisition expands Scopely's casual multiplayer portfolio alongside Monopoly GO. Financial terms were not disclosed. Kitka's 80-person team will continue operating independently from Helsinki. Scopely, itself owned by Saudi Arabia's Savvy Games Group since 2023, has been on an acquisition streak targeting high-DAU casual titles with proven social mechanics.
